name: The Kensington Hotel
positioning: The Kensington, a hotel in Victorian buildings in the heart of South Kensington, with drawing rooms, period-style rooms and signature suites, owned by The Doyle Collection
best_for: Travelers who want a base near the South Kensington museums, Kensington Gardens and Harrods
Guests who like period charm, open fires and traditional decor

facts.text: The Kensington is located in the heart of South Kensington.
The hotel is at 109 - 113 Queen's Gate, Kensington.
The hotel sits moments from The Royal Albert Hall, The Victoria and Albert Museum, Kensington Gardens and Harrods.
The hotel is set in Victorian buildings.
Guestrooms and suites blend period charm with modern comfort.
Original artwork is displayed throughout the hotel.
Lunch, dinner and Afternoon Tea are served in a Regency-period Town House setting.
The K Bar serves cocktails and an expansive wine list.
The hotel offers a London with Family package with a welcome for younger guests.
The Kensington is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group.

highlights.text: The two signature suites, the Kensington and the Brompton, are on the first floor.
The larger rooms are traditionally decorated, with features such as claw-foot baths, four-posters and working fireplaces.
The hotel's drawing rooms feature open fires, high ceilings and heritage decor.
The hotel is a short walk from the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum and the V&A.
Liveried Pashley bikes with flower-filled baskets are parked outside the hotel.

considerations.text: Room styles vary: the smaller rooms on the top floors are contemporary and streamlined, while the larger rooms are traditionally decorated.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the Kensington location.
